question: Are the ‘several other interested parties’ invited to round 2 on 08/10/2016 the unnamed NDA signers continuing from round 1, with no exit at the 08/08/2016 due date?
recommended_answer: Yes. Treat them as the Other NDA signers cohort (#9), continuing into round 2 and closed once by Did not submit at the 08/19/2016 due date (#21).
why_with_page: Invitation is to a ‘subsequent round of the potential sale process’ (p. 23); agreements with ‘several parties, including Sanofi’ (p. 22); no other offers reported. E14’s exception names events 1 and 3 only.
what_changes_if_answered_differently: #9 would get Did not submit by 08/08/2016 and Re-entered before #15.

question: Was round 2 Announced as final when the 08/14/2016 letter asked for a markup and a ‘definitive proposal’, so the 08/19/2016 ‘best and final’ request continues it?
recommended_answer: Yes: round 2 is Announced as final; #22 is a Deadline set within it and #23 a round-2 bid.
why_with_page: Markup due 08/18 and ‘definitive proposal’ due 08/19 (p. 23); ‘best and final’ requested 08/19 for 08/20 (p. 24). The conventions do not say whether ‘definitive’ means binding.
what_changes_if_answered_differently: #22 would become Round opened for round 3 (E6(b)) and #23–#25 move to round 3.

question: Does Pfizer’s agreed undertaking to divest ‘certain products’ if necessary for antitrust approval make Regulatory Concern (Antitrust Y) on its formal bids?
recommended_answer: No: Regulatory Not stated. The filing names no specific antitrust risk, only the undertaking and generic HSR language.
why_with_page: Regulatory undertakings negotiated 08/19–08/20/2016 (p. 24); divestiture undertaking (p. 33); generic HSR and second-request text (p. 44).
what_changes_if_answered_differently: #19 and #23 would take Regulatory Concern, Antitrust Y and Conditions Unclear.

question: Possible process boundary between Sanofi’s rejected April proposal and the bankers’ June outreach.
recommended_answer: One process: no 90-day gap in sale contacts (Pfizer 05/02, 05/11, 05/20/2016; bankers 06/28/2016) and no reported end of the effort.

question: Round 1 opening date and NDA dates: outreach to parties other than Pfizer and their NDAs are undated.
recommended_answer: Round 1 opens 06/28/2016 at the first dated banker outreach (Pfizer); Sanofi and other NDAs dated ‘by 07/05/2016’ from the press release.

question: Target action soon after the 08/08/2016 due date: invitation to a subsequent round on 08/10/2016.
recommended_answer: Coded as the round 2 opening; 08/08/2016 outcome Enforced.

question: Sanofi’s closure: not mentioned after its NDA and not named among the round-2 invitees.
recommended_answer: Dropped by target at the round 2 opening (not invited), Inferred, under E3’s rule for named parties in later groups and E14 event 1.
what_changes_if_answered_differently: If Sanofi was among the invitees, #16 is removed and Sanofi closes with #21’s Did not submit.

question: Rows whose identity or count rests on passages on different pages.
recommended_answer: #16: Sanofi’s NDA (p. 22) and the 08/10/2016 invitation (p. 23); #21: NDA total (p. 22) and invitees (p. 23).

question: Target board meeting at the best-and-final due date (08/20/2016).
recommended_answer: Board approved Pfizer’s $81.50 proposal the same day; 08/20/2016 outcome Enforced; signing that afternoon.
